03.10.01.d: Remove individuals from the facility access list when access is no longer required.

Evidence excerpts:
--- [Corvane_Physical_Access_Procedure_v2.3.docx] (excerpt)
4.2 Removal from Facility Access List
The Operations Manager owns the facility access list ("FAL – Assembly Floor & Stockroom", Google Sheet in the Facilities shared drive). Badges are managed in the Brivo door controller for the two exterior doors and the ESD stockroom door.
• Terminations: the Jira Service Management offboarding ticket (request type "Employee Exit") has a mandatory sub-task, "Revoke physical access." The badge must be deactivated in Brivo and the FAL row moved to the "Removed" tab on or before the person's last working day.
• Role changes and contractors: access stops on the end date written in the FAL. If no one renews it, the badge expires automatically.
• Recovered badges go in the locked drawer in the Operations office. If a badge isn't returned, it stays deactivated and is logged as lost.
• Every quarter, the Operations Manager and the IT/Security Lead compare the FAL against Okta active users and Brivo active credentials.
